left.band_definition: face_or_above: hand_y <= nose_y; shoulder_to_chest: nose_y < hand_y <= shoulder_y+(shoulder_y-nose_y); below_chest: hand_y > that line. Only classified when nose+both shoulders are above the detection threshold in that frame.

right.band_definition: face_or_above: hand_y <= nose_y; shoulder_to_chest: nose_y < hand_y <= shoulder_y+(shoulder_y-nose_y); below_chest: hand_y > that line. Only classified when nose+both shoulders are above the detection threshold in that frame.

discontinuity_candidates.note: A candidate is a frame-to-frame jump >4x that clip's own median consecutive-frame step for that hand. This is a self-calibrated discontinuity heuristic, not a confirmed identity swap — rtmlib's per-frame detect+pose call carries no persistent track ID across frames.

note: All signals here are generic kinematic quantities (position/velocity/distance/threshold bands) computed from raw tracker output. No ASL gloss, handshape, or semantic label is inferred anywhere in this file.
